```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)

options(bdat602.source_only = TRUE)
source("courses/bdat-602/_teacher/resources/datasets/simulate_bdat602_data.R")
health_data <- simulate_bdat602(n = 100000, seed = 602)
```

## Task 1: Tokenise complaint notes

```{r task1-tokenise}
# Keep only rows with non-NA complaint_notes
# Assign a document ID
# Tokenise to one word per row using unnest_tokens()
complaints <- health_data |>
  filter(!is.na(complaint_notes)) |>
  mutate(doc_id = row_number())

# TODO: unnest_tokens(word, complaint_notes) on complaints
words <- complaints |>
  NULL  # unnest_tokens(word, complaint_notes)

# How many total word tokens are there?
cat("Total tokens:", nrow(words), "\n")
```

```{r task1-top-raw}
# TODO: count the most frequent words (before stop word removal)
# Show the top 20
words |>
  count(word, sort = TRUE) |>
  head(20)
```

## Task 2: Remove stop words

```{r task2-stop-words}
# TODO: use anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") to remove stop words
words_clean <- words |>
  NULL  # anti_join(...)

cat("Tokens after stop word removal:", nrow(words_clean), "\n")
```

```{r task2-top-clean}
# TODO: show the top 20 most frequent words after stop word removal
# Plot as a bar chart
words_clean |>
  count(word, sort = TRUE) |>
  head(20) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(word, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Words in Complaint Notes (after stop word removal)",
       x = "Word", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Task 3: Compute TF-IDF

```{r task3-tfidf}
# TODO: count words per document, then apply bind_tf_idf()
word_counts <- words_clean |>
  count(NULL, NULL)  # count(doc_id, word)

tfidf_df <- word_counts |>
  bind_tf_idf(NULL, NULL, NULL)  # bind_tf_idf(word, doc_id, n)

# Show the top 10 rows sorted by tf_idf descending
tfidf_df |>
  arrange(desc(tf_idf)) |>
  head(10)
```

## Task 4: Top TF-IDF words per complaint category

The complaint templates in the simulator fall into 5 categories:
billing, claims, coverage, service, positive.

```{r task4-category}
# Add a category label to each complaint based on keywords in the text
complaints_cat <- complaints |>
  mutate(category = case_when(
    str_detect(complaint_notes, "billing|premium|deductible|charged|payment|balance") ~ "billing",
    str_detect(complaint_notes, "claim|pending|denied|submitted|approved|documents")  ~ "claims",
    str_detect(complaint_notes, "covered|coverage|prescription|formulary|dental|mental|physiotherapy|doctor") ~ "coverage",
    str_detect(complaint_notes, "customer service|app|portal|hold|transferred|emails|phone") ~ "service",
    TRUE ~ "positive"
  ))

# TODO: join category back to tfidf_df (join on doc_id)
tfidf_cat <- tfidf_df |>
  left_join(complaints_cat |> select(doc_id, category), by = "doc_id")
```

```{r task4-plot}
# TODO: for each category, find the top 8 words by mean tf_idf
# Plot as a faceted bar chart (one panel per category)
tfidf_cat |>
  group_by(category, word) |>
  summarise(mean_tfidf = mean(tf_idf), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(category) |>
  slice_max(mean_tfidf, n = 8) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder_within(word, mean_tfidf, category),
             y = mean_tfidf, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~category, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top TF-IDF Words by Complaint Category",
       x = "Word", y = "Mean TF-IDF") +
  theme_minimal()
```
